code='''def transform(grid):
    # Split at the uniform nonzero separator, then mark overlapping cells.
    sep_row = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    sep_col = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0]))
                   if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and grid[0][c] != 0)
    left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
'''
f.write_text(code)
exec(compile(f.read_text(),str(f),'exec'))
out=transform(test)
print(out)
